input.agent_derivation: Habery salt Salter(raw=salt).qb64, hab name agent-{controller}, namespace agent

reference_quirks.replay_until_rotation: A captured request verifies until the agent sees the controller rotate: the timestamp, `created` and `expires` are all unchecked.
reference_quirks.sender_chooses_coverage: Inbound verifies whichever fields Signature-Input lists, skipping absent headers and unknown `@` fields, so nothing requires any field to be covered.
reference_quirks.malformed_headers_vary: Only AuthNError, ValueError and UnicodeDecodeError become 401. Other exceptions from parsing a header escape the middleware as an unsigned 500.
reference_quirks.unsigned_without_agent: A response is signed only if authentication put an agent on the request, so 401s, those 500s, allowed paths and CORS preflights are unsigned; a handler's 404 is signed.
reference_quirks.sealed_salt: `sxlt` is a sealed box, fixed here; a real client's differs on every call.
reference_quirks.path_is_requoted: hio passes `quote(unquote(raw))` as the path, inbound verifies that, and outbound signs `quote(unquote(path))`. So `:` is verified as `%3A`, and a client must sign the same form.
reference_quirks.server_headers: hio adds `Server` and `Date` on a real socket; they are absent here.
